nodes.name: use fewer bins on the benchmark instances
nodes.frame: Nothing is solved yet. A rule must place each arriving item, once and for good, into an open bin or a new bin; it is judged by the bins used relative to the total size, averaged over seeded instances.
assumptions: items must be placed the moment they arrive
a placed item never moves
the rule sees only the current item and the current bin fills

proposals.proposal: judge by loss on rare tokens, not mean loss (footprint)
proposals.reframing: the mean over all tokens hides the tail; model the tail separately.
proposals.new_measure: validation loss on the 10 percent rarest tokens, from the same held-out file.
proposals.why: mean loss is dominated by frequent tokens, so tail gains are invisible.
proposals.cost: a token-frequency table and one extra pass of the eval.

proposals.proposal: judge by loss after a fixed wall-clock budget (footprint)
proposals.reframing: fixed time instead of fixed tokens.
proposals.new_measure: validation loss at 10 minutes of training on the reference GPU.
proposals.why: a fixed token budget cannot see a faster step.
proposals.cost: a timed training harness and repeated runs to control timing noise.
